title: Variance-dampener and hybrid selector for FP8 enablement on Hopper (E4M3/E5M2)
creator: Maya Chen
description:
Goal: Safely enable FP8 (E4M3/E5M2) profiles for a selected subset of Hopper-serving models by introducing a variance-dampening preprocessing stage and a hybrid selection heuristic that combines per-shard sensitivity scores with run-time telemetry. This ticket covers design, calibration runs, CI gating, canary rollout, and rollback logic.

Background: Our previous calibration runs show transient accuracy degradations during bursty workloads and tail latency spikes caused by per-shard activation variance when switching to E4M3/E5M2. Existing selector heuristics are brittle under micro-burst traffic and do not account for short-term variance amplification. We need a compensating strategy that reduces activation variance during inference and chooses profiles conservatively when telemetry indicates instability.

Scope: Prototype and validate two new components: 1) a lightweight variance-dampening layer applied to activations prior to quantization (algorithmic, no model retrain), and 2) a hybrid selector that merges offline sensitivity maps with live telemetry (latency jitter, KV cache hit rate, token-pattern entropy) to gate activation of E4M3/E5M2 profiles. Deliverables include calibration artifacts, automated evaluation harness, rollout plan, dashboarding, and remediation playbook.
acceptance_criteria: End-to-end p95 latency regression < 5% compared to baseline INT8 for canary workload
Aggregate generation quality (ROUGE-L and token-level perplexity proxies) within 0.5% of FP16 baseline on calibration suite
No customer-facing error-rate increase in 72h canary (errors, retries, top-1 mismatch)
Selector false-positive rate < 2% on historical traffic replay and synthetic burst tests
Automated CI convergence: calibration job completes within 6 hours for target models and produces an activation map artifact
Rollback automation triggers when stability score drops below threshold and completes safe fallback to INT8/FP16 without dropping inflight requests
proposed_solution:
Introduce a numerical damping operator applied to activation tensors immediately before quantization: a lightweight per-channel variance clamp combined with exponential moving median smoothing (configurable window). Implement this as a switchable operator in the serving runtime to avoid model rebuilds. Build a hybrid selector service that computes a runtime stability score by combining: (a) offline sensitivity heatmap per layer/shard from calibration runs, (b) live KV-cache hit ratio, (c) short-window latency jitter, and (d) per-request token-entropy estimate. The selector outputs: ENABLE / HOLD / FORCE-FALLBACK with hysteresis and cooldown. Provide config knobs for aggressiveness and a telemetry-based circuit breaker.

Rationale: Dampening reduces amplification of quantization noise during bursts, while the hybrid selector reduces surface area of erroneous activations by combining prior knowledge and live signals. Keeping the dampener runtime-switchable enables rapid rollback and A/B testing without re-training or packaging new model artifacts.
implementation_steps: 1) Design and spec variance-dampener operator (math, numerical stability, perf budget)
2) Implement operator in serving runtime with CPU/GPU pathways and microbenchmarks
3) Add selector scoring pipeline in routing layer; expose selector decisions via trace headers
4) Create calibration job: generate per-layer sensitivity maps with new dampener off/on
4a) Save artifacts to golden-bucket and register in model-catalog metadata
5) Run offline evaluation: replay historical traffic, synthetic bursts, and edge-cases
6) Build CI gating: calibration job, smoke-evals, and automated quality checks
7) Deploy to internal canary fleet (10% of hopper pool), monitor for 72h
8) Gradual rollout with automatic rollback criteria and on-call runbook
9) Post-rollout telemetry analysis and long-term tuning plan
telemetry_and_gating: Stability score (0..100) constructed from sensitivity-weighted jitter and cache metrics
Per-model and per-shard counters: dampener-applied, selector-decision (ENABLE/HOLD/FALLBACK)
Quality deltas: rouge-l, perplexity proxy, top-k token divergence vs FP16 baseline
Alerting: stability_score < 55 for 10m => notify SRE and pause new activations
Gating: CI fails if any model shows >0.5% quality regression on calibration suite
test_plan: Unit tests for dampener numeric behavior (edge saturation, NaN/Inf handling)
Microbenchmarks for operator overhead on Hopper (E4M3/E5M2) across batch sizes
Calibration-run integration: generate sensitivity maps for at least 6 representative models
Replay tests: run 7-day production traffic replay with injected bursts and compare selector accuracy
Canary acceptance: 72h canary with automated checks and manual review checkpoint
Chaos experiments: simulated node preemption and KV-cache thrash to validate fallback resiliency
